# Airbnb Singapore

> > Airbnb Singapore's platform for discovering local experiences, activities, and tours across destinations in Asia, Europe, and beyond.

Airbnb Singapore connects travelers with curated experiences and activities in destinations worldwide, featuring cultural tours, heritage walks, outdoor adventures, and local cooking classes. The platform emphasizes authentic local experiences with guided tours and activities ranging from temple visits in India to island hopping in Thailand and hiking in Norway.

## Key Topics

- Airbnb Experiences
- Local cultural activities
- Walking and heritage tours
- Guided tours and activities
- Temple and religious site visits
- Island tours and water activities
- Cooking classes and culinary experiences
- Outdoor adventures and hiking
- Southeast Asian destinations (Indonesia, Thailand)
- Indian heritage sites (Amritsar, Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh)
- Krabi and Ao Nang activities
- Balinese and regional cooking
- Border ceremonies (Attari Wagah Border)
- City walking tours
- Kayaking and water sports

## India Experiences & Cultural Tours

- [Things to do in Amritsar](https://www.airbnb.com.sg/amritsar-india/things-to-do): Amritsar experiences: Golden Temple tours, Wagah Border, heritage walks

## Thailand Activities & Island Tours

- [Things to do in Ao Nang](https://www.airbnb.com.sg/ao-nang-thailand/things-to-do): Ao Nang activities: Phi Phi Islands tours, kayaking, cooking classes

## Indonesia Experiences & Adventures

- [Things to do in Buleleng Regency](https://www.airbnb.com.sg/buleleng-regency-indonesia/things-to-do): Buleleng activities: Mount Batur sunrise, jeep tours, Balinese cooking
- [Things to do in Bantul Regency](https://www.airbnb.com.sg/bantul-regency-indonesia/things-to-do): Bantul experiences: Borobudur & Prambanan temples, food & walking tours

## European Destinations & Outdoor Activities

- [Things to do in Bergen](https://www.airbnb.com.sg/bergen-norway/things-to-do): Bergen experiences: hiking Løvstakken, city tours, outdoor activities
